notes.title: May 24 Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a crash when using a controller wile Steam Input was disabled.

notes.title: March 19 Hot Fix
notes.notes: Fixed an error when the gnome "drops in" while the game is running at a low frame rate. He should no longer get stuck out of bounds when the performance is bad.

notes.notes: -Fixed a small bug with projectile shooting enemies.
